name: benchmark-afriMedQA-IFT
description: A medical question-answering dataset focused on African contexts and medical knowledge, used to evaluate models' ability to answer clinically relevant questions that may reflect regional disease profiles and presentation. It contains QA pairs possibly in multiple languages or with region-specific content and is intended to test factual correctness and clinical relevance. The dataset supports both short-answer and multiple-choice evaluation formats.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark with recognition among researchers focused on African medical NLP but limited broader adoption.
